description: For every relation \(A\) on \(k\)-tuples from a set \(M\) and a set \(N\), \((\forall\bar x\,\exists y\,A(\bar x,y))\) holds if and only if some function \(f:M^k\to N\) satisfies \(A(\bar x,f(\bar x))\) for every tuple \(\bar x\).
signature:
Classical.skolem.{u, v} {α : Sort u} {b : α → Sort v} {p : (x : α) → b x → Prop} :
  (∀ (x : α), ∃ y, p x y) ↔ ∃ f, ∀ (x : α), p x (f x)
